summary.intent: Generate a milestone v1.1 summary for team onboarding, then document all tech debt as tracked todos and open a docs PR capturing what was built, key decisions, and open work.
summary.outcome: PR #515 opened on branch `docs/milestone-v1.1-summary-and-tech-debt` (commit `0c394aef5`) containing MILESTONE_SUMMARY-v1.1.md, TECH_DEBT-v1.1.md, 5 net-new pending todo files (24 verified-open findings), a BACKLOG.md dated pointer, and a corrected ROADMAP.md with all 34 phases listed.

repo: Tech debt is tracked in two complementary places: `.planning/BACKLOG.md` (consolidated inventory) and `.planning/todos/pending/YYYY-MM-DD-*.md` (dated actionable files); new items must go in both to be discoverable.

The repo uses per-component semver tags (`cipher-box-vX.Y.Z`), not milestone-level tags — `v1.1` tag does not exist, so git stats require a commit-boundary fallback via earliest `.planning/phases/` commit.
`.planning/` is listed in `.markdownlintignore`, so pre-commit markdownlint/lint-staged skips all planning docs — no linting friction when writing there.

Phase `REVIEW.md` files are the richest source of untracked tech debt: phase 42 had no resolution section (all 12 WR/IN findings still open); phase 43 had a 'Post-Review Resolution (2026-06-14)' section confirming criticals fixed but warnings unresolved.

The milestone summary erroneously claimed ledger close-out commits #512/#513 resolved phases 18/31/32 verification gaps — those commits only covered phases 19.2/23/27/47-49; phases 18, 31, and 32 still lack VERIFICATION.md.
ROADMAP.md's Phase Details section was accurate (all 18–49), but the summary table and Phases checklist were stale: checklist stopped at phase 35 and was missing 19.1, 27, and phases 36–49.
Main branch is protected — always branch + PR, never commit directly to main.
workflow: Workflow synthesize agents fail in a schema-validation retry loop when asked to emit 200+ nested items as a single StructuredOutput call; better pattern is sweep agents returning raw arrays and synthesizing in the main context with BACKLOG cross-reference.

Stopping a stuck workflow agent (`TaskStop`) and doing synthesis manually is faster and more accurate when the agent has wedged: the manual pass can verify each candidate against current code rather than trusting artifact text alone.
Phase completion dates are best derived from `git log --diff-filter=A --follow -- <phase_dir>` when SUMMARY.md frontmatter lacks a `completed_at` field.
Scheduled wakeup fallbacks can fire after the task has already completed in the same session — always check current state before re-executing work.

friction: Workflow synthesize agent (effort: high, 292 raw items) wedged in schema-validation retry loop for 13+ minutes before being manually stopped — largest single delay in the session.
No milestone-level git tag meant git stats required a multi-step fallback (earliest `.planning/phases/` commit), adding complexity to the stats section.

Milestone summary's audit-gap claim was wrong (18/31/32 not actually closed), requiring a post-hoc correction edit — an error introduced by trusting STATE.md 100%-complete status rather than verifying artifact presence.
Scheduled fallback wakeup fired after task completion, requiring a no-op confirmation step.
open_items: Phase 42 unpin integrity: 12 open WR/IN findings including WR-01 (INT_MIN advisory-lock overflow → permanent undeletability) and WR-03 (stale-outbox re-pin race → potential data loss) — tracked in `2026-06-18-phase42-unpin-integrity-review-open-findings.md`.
FUSE journal: WR-06 (unbounded journal growth, full ciphertext stored in JSON, no GC) and WR-07 (replay has no network timeout) — tracked in `2026-06-18-fuse-journal-growth-and-replay-timeout.md`.

Web/SDK observability: logger `redact()` never implemented, `registerFaroTransport` defined but never called (warn/error not reaching Faro) — tracked in `2026-06-18-web-logger-redaction-and-faro-transport-unwired.md`.
P29 unenroll skips unloaded subtrees — tracked in `2026-06-18-unenroll-skips-unloaded-subtrees.md`.
GSD process gaps: phases 18, 31, 32 still lack VERIFICATION.md; PERF-01..04 requirements orphaned — tracked in `2026-06-18-gsd-verification-gaps-phases-18-31-32.md`.

Deferred to v1.2+: Rust FUSE 409-merge approximates TS op-replay (can stomp remote-only changes), BYO provider.unpin not wired into client delete flows, writable-share version-prune leak, CRDT IPNS inbox, advisory folder_ipns cache, client-direct upload, desktop code-signing, pending-uploads UI.
